about: The single reviewed iOS anchor evidence table (epic 16774), schema 3. Families are (machine, base architecture header digest, artifact tier, proof-backed activation variant). Checkpoints with identical base tensor names, shapes, dtypes and packing share a family; component-additive modes derive from its text anchor. Per family: resident rung 0 (a typed pre-allocation quantum refusal is evidence), optimized cheapest deepest implemented selection (two completed captures; their spread is the margin, floored at 32 MiB). Each capture records baseline and lifetime kernel footprint, phase peaks, per-quantum device observations, elapsed time and run/build provenance. Other regimes/geometries derive by mlx_gen::ios_anchor_law; incompatible variants fail closed. Capture output is review material, never runtime authority. No host measurements are admission rows.
